record_type_quote:
We were able to replicate the factor structure of the Short
Test of Music Preferences (STOMP, Rentfrow & Gosling,
2003) with a German sample in a CFA model.

targets.authors: Rentfrow, P. J., & Gosling, S. D.
targets.title: The do re mi’s of everyday life: The structure and personality correlates of music preferences.
targets.evidence_quote:
Therefore, we compared the correlations computed
based on mean scores to previous findings (Table 5), which
showed by and large similar patterns and correlations as in
previous studies (Delsing et al., 2008; George et al., 2007;
Rentfrow & Gosling, 2003; Zweigenhaft, 2008).
targets.outcome_quote:
All in all, the results of the studies from the United States
and The Netherlands regarding the factor structure of the
STOMP dimensions as well as the correlations between
music preferences and personality also apply to the German
sample.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The paper explicitly compares the same published personality/music correlations in new German data. Its overall verdict states these prior findings apply to the German sample; discussion names this paper within the set described as generally consistent.
